editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — I checked every quantitative and conditional claim (five cut edges, six Pauli strings for six edges, five elements per string, "IIIZZ"/"ZIZII", γ=π/2 and β=π, the fourth true solution ranking fifth, 32 possible bitstrings, four true max-cut solutions, "two layers"), and none drifted; no hallucinated sentences, no inverted negation, no dropped caveat. What a native technical editor would fix is word-level: several malformed/misformed verbs ("lululusin" for lulutasin, "Magtatatapos tayo ng anim na bagay" for "we'll end up with six objects", "hindi tinuktukoy" for tinutukoy, "evo-evolve"), and a cluster of literal-but-wrong calques — "which we have not yet covered" → "hindi pa natin natatakpan" (physically covered over), "coming up with the mixer Hamiltonian" → "ang pagdating sa mixer Hamiltonian" (arriving at), "as previously described" → "tulad ng naibigay na inilarawan", and "rough first guesses" → "magaslaw na unang mga hula" (magaslaw means boisterous/uncouth, not magaspang/rough). "Qiskit allows you to use a different mixer" is rendered ungrammatically as "Binibigyan ka ng Qiskit na gumamit ng iba". Informal register holds consistently (no po/opo), and core terms (qubit, gate, ansatz, Hamiltonian, cost function, transpile, backend, shots, superposition) are kept in English consistently, which is the right convention here.

examples.source: the evolution under the mixer Hamiltonian, which we have not yet covered, in light purple.
examples.suggested: ... na hindi pa natin natatalakay, sa maliwanag na kulay lila.
examples.translation: ang evolution sa ilalim ng mixer Hamiltonian, na hindi pa natin natatakpan, sa maliwanag na kulay lila.
examples.why: "Covered" in the pedagogical sense (discussed) is rendered with "natatakpan", which in Tagalog means physically covered over/obscured. Comprehensible from context but reads as a dictionary false-friend, not something a technical writer would write.

examples.source: Qiskit allows you to use a different, custom mixer operator if you wish ... making coming up with the mixer Hamiltonian and the starting state trivial.
examples.suggested: Pinapayagan ka ng Qiskit na gumamit ng ibang custom na mixer operator kung gusto mo ... na ginagawang trivial ang pagbuo ng mixer Hamiltonian at ng panimulang estado.
examples.translation: Binibigyan ka ng Qiskit na gumamit ng iba, custom na mixer operator kung gusto mo ... na ginagawang trivial ang pagdating sa mixer Hamiltonian at sa panimulang estado.
examples.why: "Binibigyan ka ng Qiskit na gumamit" is ungrammatical (binigyan needs an object), and "pagdating sa" literalizes "coming up with" as "arriving at" — the intended sense is constructing/deriving.

examples.source: we're going to solve using an algorithm called QAOA / We'll end up with six objects / we can't actually run the circuit without specifying these parameters
examples.suggested: na lulutasin natin ... / Magkakaroon tayo ng anim na bagay ... / nang hindi tinutukoy ang mga parameter na ito
examples.translation: na lululusin natin gamit ang isang algorithm ... / Magtatatapos tayo ng anim na bagay ... / nang hindi tinuktukoy ang mga parameter na ito
examples.why: Three malformed verb forms (lululusin, Magtatatapos, tinuktukoy) — reduplication/affix errors a native writer would not produce; they read as generation artifacts rather than typos of intent.

examples.source: We need to find better values of gamma and beta than just our rough first guesses.
examples.suggested: ... kaysa sa ating magagaspang na unang mga hula.
examples.translation: Kailangan nating makahanap ng mas magandang mga halaga ng gamma at beta kaysa sa ating magaslaw na unang mga hula.
examples.why: "Magaslaw" means boisterous/uncouth in Tagalog, not "rough/approximate"; the intended word is magaspang. Meaning survives because "unang mga hula" carries it, so this is a word-choice slip rather than a misleading statement.

editor_note: No misleading content: all probabilities, the $T_2 \le 2T_1$ constraint, the reset-to-1/`p_reset` bullet, the $P(A|B)$ recorded-vs-true bit definitions, and the qubit-order caveat ("mahalaga ang pagkakasunod ng mga qubit ... [0, 1] ... iba sa ... [1, 0]") all survive intact. The recurring slip is the verb for "acts on": it is rendered "kinakatawan nito" (= "that it represents") twice in the Add-errors section, but correctly as "kumikilos sa" one section later — same concept, two renderings, one of them semantically off though not concept-breaking. Smaller nits: "in the presence of errors" is calqued as "sa harap ng mga error"; "That suggests you should ... run the pass just before running the simulator" is flattened to "Ibig sabihin nito ..." with "just" dropped; and one paragraph mixes exclusive "aming mga demonstrasyon" with inclusive "gumagamit tayo".

examples.source: we must specify the type of *instruction* that it acts on and what qubits to apply it to. / regardless of which qubits it acts on
examples.suggested: ... ang uri ng *instruction* na kinikilusan nito at kung saang mga qubit ito ilalapat ... / anuman ang mga qubit na kinikilusan nito.
examples.translation: kailangan nating tukuyin ang uri ng *instruction* na kinakatawan nito ... / anuman ang mga qubit na kinakatawan nito.
examples.why: "kinakatawan" means "represents", not "acts on"; the same relation is rendered correctly as "kumikilos sa" in the very next subsection (line 320), so the file splits one concept across two verbs, one of which is wrong.

examples.source: That suggests you should write your own transpiler pass ... and run the pass just before running the simulator if you need to insert your quantum errors ...
examples.suggested: Ipinapahiwatig nito na ... at patakbuhin ang pass mismo bago patakbuhin ang simulator.
examples.translation: Ibig sabihin nito, kung kailangan mong ipasok ang iyong mga quantum error ... dapat kang sumulat ng sariling transpiler pass ... at patakbuhin ang pass bago patakbuhin ang simulator.
examples.why: "suggests" is hardened to "Ibig sabihin nito" (that means), and the timing emphasis "just before" loses its "just" — the instruction still reads correctly but the hedge and the immediacy cue are gone.

examples.source: for simulating quantum circuits in the presence of errors
examples.suggested: para sa pag-simulate ng mga quantum circuit na may mga error / sa presensya ng mga error
examples.translation: para sa pag-simulate ng mga quantum circuit sa harap ng mga error
examples.why: "sa harap ng" is a literal calque ("in front of"); a Tagalog technical writer would say "na may mga error" or "sa presensya ng ingay".

examples.source: For our demonstrations we use a simple test circuit generating an n-qubit GHZ state
examples.suggested: Para sa ating mga demonstrasyon, gumagamit tayo ng ...
examples.translation: Para sa aming mga demonstrasyon, gumagamit tayo ng simpleng test circuit na gumagawa ng n-Qubit GHZ state
examples.why: Exclusive "aming" (excludes the reader) collides with inclusive "tayo" in the same sentence; the rest of the page consistently uses the inclusive we ("Isaalang-alang natin", "kailangan nating").

editor_note: No misleading drift: negations ("Hindi ito available sa mga estudyante..."), quantities (400 minuto, 120 qubit, ~30 transpiled two-qubit depth, 30-120 minuto, ~10x, ~30%), and the "Hindi ito isang mas mabilis na pangkalahatang layunin na computer" caveat all survive intact, and the register is correctly casual (no po/opo). What a native technical editor would change is lexis: "novel" is rendered as "nobela/nobelang" four times ("nobelang quantum computing research", "mga nobelang natuklasan", "mga nobelang gamot"), a false friend that in Tagalog means the literary novel — it should be "bago/makabago" (the same word is left as English "novel" in the resources table, so it is also inconsistent). "Proof of principle" is consistently inverted to "prinsipyo ng patunay" ("principle of proof") instead of "patunay ng prinsipyo", and "regional seeds" (seed grants) becomes the literal "mga regional na buto". Several English-syntax calques persist: "makatotohanan nang ibinibigay ang mga hiniling na mapagkukunan" for "realistic given the resources requested", "ma-optimize ang angkop" for "optimize fit", and "Maging maingat na" (be cautious) for "Be mindful that" (isaisip/tandaan).

examples.source: the minimum access for novel quantum computing research ... novel discoveries ... novel pharmaceuticals
examples.suggested: para sa bagong (makabagong) quantum computing research ... mga bagong natuklasan ... mga bagong gamot
examples.translation: para sa nobelang quantum computing research ... mga nobelang natuklasan ... mga nobelang gamot
examples.why: "nobela" in Tagalog means the literary novel; as an adjective for "new/novel" it is a false friend. The resources table leaves the same word untranslated ("Mga novel na pamamaraan"), so the file is also inconsistent.

examples.source: Carry out initial work as proof of principle ... Initial work as proof-of-principle
examples.suggested: paunang trabaho bilang patunay ng prinsipyo (o panatilihin ang "proof-of-principle")
examples.translation: Magsagawa ng paunang trabaho bilang prinsipyo ng patunay ... Paunang trabaho bilang prinsipyo ng patunay
examples.why: The genitive is inverted: "prinsipyo ng patunay" back-translates as "principle of proof". Consistent, so recognizable, but it is the wrong direction of the compound.

examples.source: Curated lists of quantum-specific opportunities from NSF, DOE, DoD, and regional seeds
examples.suggested: ... at mga regional na seed grant
examples.translation: Mga curated na listahan ng mga partikular na pagkakataon ng quantum mula sa NSF, DOE, DoD, at mga regional na buto
examples.why: "buto" is the literal plant seed/bone; in a funding list it reads as nonsense where "seed grant/seed funding" is meant.

examples.source: List concrete deliverables that are realistic given the resources requested and time constraints.
examples.suggested: ... na makatotohanan batay sa mga hiniling na mapagkukunan at mga limitasyon sa oras.
examples.translation: Maglista ng mga kongkretong deliverable na makatotohanan nang ibinibigay ang mga hiniling na mapagkukunan at mga limitasyon sa oras.
examples.why: "nang ibinibigay" is a word-for-word calque of concessive "given" (as if "while being given"); a native writer would use "batay sa" or "isinasaalang-alang ang".

examples.source: Be mindful that the biggest impact applications are likely to leverage both quantum and high-performance computing.
examples.suggested: Tandaan na ang mga aplikasyong may pinakamalaking epekto ay malamang na gumamit ng parehong quantum at high-performance computing.
examples.translation: Maging maingat na ang mga pinakamalaking impactful na aplikasyon ay malamang na gagamit ng parehong quantum at high-performance computing.
examples.why: "Maging maingat" means "be cautious/careful", turning a keep-in-mind pointer into a warning; "pinakamalaking impactful" is also an ungrammatical mix of Tagalog superlative and English adjective.

examples.source: Tracks small business quantum grants in algorithms, computing, sensing, and more.
examples.suggested: Sinusubaybayan ang mga quantum grant para sa maliliit na negosyo sa mga algorithm, computing, sensing, at marami pa.
examples.translation: Sinusubaybayan ang mga maliit na negosyo ng quantum grant sa mga algorithm, computing, sensing, at marami pa.
examples.why: The English noun stack is mis-parsed: the translation says "the small businesses of quantum grant" rather than "quantum grants for small businesses".

editor_note: No misleading content: the batch/session notes, the four-step TTL workflow (including the "hanggang hindi naabot ang katapusan" rendering of "does not stop or pause until the end is reached" and the cost-limit caveat in step 4) all track the English faithfully, and domain terms (job/batch/session/primitive/PUB/QPU/backend/variational algorithm/TTL) are kept in English consistently. Three small things a native technical editor would fix: the opening sentence renders "users could only execute circuits as individual jobs" as "ang mga user ay makakagawa lamang ng mga circuit" — "makakagawa" is future-tense and means "make", not "execute", clashing with the past-tense "Nang ilunsad ang Qiskit Runtime"; "Ilinalarawan" (line 57) is a misformed verb, correct Tagalog is "Inilalarawan"; and the batch paragraph mixes aspects ("Ini-parallelize ... tini-thread" present vs "patatakbuhin" future) in one descriptive sentence. Also "lumabas ang iba't ibang uri ng quantum workload" for "as different types of workloads emerged" is a calque — "lumitaw" is the natural technical choice.

examples.source: When Qiskit Runtime was introduced, users could only execute circuits as individual jobs.
examples.suggested: Nang ilunsad ang Qiskit Runtime, maaari lamang magpatakbo ang mga user ng mga circuit bilang mga indibidwal na job.
examples.translation: Nang ilunsad ang Qiskit Runtime, ang mga user ay makakagawa lamang ng mga circuit bilang mga indibidwal na job.
examples.why: "makakagawa" is future-tense "will be able to make", not past-tense "could execute"; it both breaks the historical framing set by "Nang ilunsad" and swaps "execute" for "make".

examples.source: The following video illustrates the basic workflow, using sessions as an example:
examples.suggested: Inilalarawan ng sumusunod na video ang pangunahing workflow, gamit ang mga session bilang halimbawa:
examples.translation: Ilinalarawan ng sumusunod na video ang pangunahing workflow, gamit ang mga session bilang halimbawa:
examples.why: "Ilinalarawan" is a malformed conjugation of larawan; the correct imperfective is "Inilalarawan". A native writer would never produce this form.

examples.source: The system parallelizes or threads the pre-processing ... and then runs the quantum execution of each job in quick succession
examples.suggested: ... at pagkatapos ay pinatatakbo ang quantum execution ng bawat job nang mabilisang sunud-sunod
examples.translation: Ini-parallelize o tini-thread ng sistema ang pre-processing ... at pagkatapos ay patatakbuhin ang quantum execution ng bawat job nang sunud-sunod
examples.why: Aspect shifts mid-sentence from imperfective (Ini-parallelize) to contemplative/future (patatakbuhin) in what is a general description of system behavior; "quick" in "quick succession" is also dropped.

examples.source: As different types of quantum workloads emerged, the need for different scheduling strategies became evident.
examples.suggested: Habang lumitaw ang iba't ibang uri ng quantum workload, naging malinaw ang pangangailangan para sa iba't ibang estratehiya sa scheduling.
examples.translation: Habang lumabas ang iba't ibang uri ng quantum workload, naging malinaw ang pangangailangan para sa iba't ibang estratehiya sa scheduling.
examples.why: "lumabas" (came out, exited) is a literal calque of "emerged"; the idiomatic technical verb for a phenomenon arising is "lumitaw".

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — the lattice/SVP/CVP/BDD/LWE chain, the Module-LWE-as-compromise paragraph, and the IND-CPA/IND-CCA two-step FO argument all land correctly, and the informal "titingnan natin / tayo" register holds with no po/opo. What a native technical editor would still fix are word-choice and syntax slips: "humahampas ng random na error/noise contribution" (line ~292) uses a verb meaning "lashes/slaps" where the English says "approximates"; "katangian at ari-arian ng lattice" (line ~114) renders "properties" as "ari-arian" (possessions/assets) instead of "mga katangian/ari" in the physical sense; "Ng pangunahing kahalagahan ay dalawang computational na problema" (line ~102) is a bare calque of "Of fundamental importance are…" that no Tagalog writer would open a sentence with; and "mula sa pamamagitan ng mga initialization vector" (line ~509) and "hindi bababa ang antas ng seguridad" (line ~527) are ungrammatical. Two small drifts: "shortlisted by NIST" becomes "inirekomenda ng NIST" (recommended — stronger than shortlisted), and "namely" is rendered twice as "katulad ng" ("such as"), which weakens an exhaustive list into an illustrative one. None of these would teach a false concept.

examples.source: we need a simple function that approximates random error/noise contributions ε drawn from a discrete Gaussian distribution χ
examples.suggested: kailangan natin ng simpleng function na tumatantiya sa mga random na error/noise contribution ε na kinukuha mula sa isang discrete Gaussian distribution χ
examples.translation: kailangan natin ng simpleng function na humahampas ng random na error/noise contribution ε mula sa isang discrete Gaussian distribution χ
examples.why: 'Humahampas' means 'lashes/slaps' — it is not a rendering of 'approximates' at all and reads as a garbled word swap in the middle of the Python walkthrough.

examples.source: altering the basis changes the lattice's characteristics and properties
examples.suggested: ang pagbabago ng basis ay nagbabago sa mga katangian at katangiang pisikal ng lattice
examples.translation: ang pagbabago ng basis ay nagbabago ng mga katangian at ari-arian ng lattice
examples.why: 'Ari-arian' means possessions/assets (real property), a literal-but-wrong rendering of 'properties' in the physical/mathematical sense.

examples.source: Of fundamental importance are two computational problems on lattices, namely the shortest vector problem and the learning with errors problem
examples.suggested: Napakahalaga ng dalawang computational na problema sa mga lattice: ang shortest vector problem at ang learning with errors problem
examples.translation: Ng pangunahing kahalagahan ay dalawang computational na problema sa mga lattice, katulad ng shortest vector problem at ang learning with errors problem
examples.why: Opening with 'Ng' is a direct calque of the English inversion and is ungrammatical in Tagalog; 'katulad ng' also turns the exhaustive 'namely' into an illustrative 'such as' (same slip at line ~474 for the three Kyber steps).

examples.source: For example one of the initial algorithms shortlisted by NIST was subsequently cracked and proven to be insecure.
examples.suggested: Halimbawa, isa sa mga paunang algorithm na naisama ng NIST sa shortlist ay kalaunang na-crack at napatunayang hindi secure.
examples.translation: Halimbawa, isa sa mga algorithm na inirekomenda ng NIST sa unang pagkakataon ay na-crack at napatunayang hindi secure.
examples.why: 'Inirekomenda' (recommended) is a stronger claim than 'shortlisted' — it implies NIST endorsed an algorithm it had only listed as a candidate.

examples.source: In this case we know that the origin supplied is close to the lattice, but not how close, ie bounded.
examples.suggested: Sa kasong ito, alam natin na ang ibinigay na pinagmulan ay malapit sa lattice, ngunit hindi natin alam kung *gaano kalapit*, ibig sabihin, *bounded*.
examples.translation: Sa kasong ito, alam natin na ang ibinigay na pinagmulan ay malapit sa lattice, ngunit hindi *gaano kalayo*, ibig sabihin, *bounded*.
examples.why: 'Gaano kalayo' (how far) flips the English 'how close', and without 'hindi natin alam' the clause can be misread as 'but not very far' rather than 'but not how close'.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — the Bell-state walkthrough, the "halos pantay na hatian sa pagitan ng '00' at '11'" expectation, the 000/111 three-qubit variation and the `qc.x(1)` tip all match the English, and the register stays informal (no po/opo). Three editor-level slips, none misleading: (1) "entangled" is rendered three different ways within the file — "dalawang magkaugnay na qubit" (line 136, which reads merely as "connected/related" and is the weakest of the three), "na-entangle na" (line 180) and the kept English "quantum entanglement" (line 174); the field convention here is the borrowed verb, so line 136 should be "dalawang qubit na magkaugnay (entangled)" or "na-entangle". (2) Line 64 mixes verb focus mid-sentence — "madali mo itong mabubura at magsisimula ulit" leaves "magsisimula" without its actor, where a native writer would say "madali mo itong mabubura at makakapagsimula kang muli"; it also uses "kapag" (when) for the English conditional "if". (3) Line 186's link label was flattened to the bare page title "[Hello world]" instead of the English's descriptive "Run your first circuit on hardware" — the trailing clause preserves the sense, but the label no longer tells the reader what the link does.

examples.source: ...to build a Bell state (two entangled qubits).
examples.suggested: ...para gumawa ng Bell state (dalawang qubit na na-entangle).
examples.translation: ...para gumawa ng Bell state (dalawang magkaugnay na qubit).
examples.why: "magkaugnay" only conveys "related/connected" and understates entanglement; the same file later uses "na-entangle na" (line 180) and "quantum entanglement" (line 174), so the core concept is rendered three ways within one short page.

examples.source: One important advantage of a virtual environment is that if your Python environment becomes corrupted, you can easily delete it and start over!
examples.suggested: Isang mahalagang kalamangan ng virtual environment ay kung masira ang iyong Python environment, madali mo itong mabubura at makakapagsimula kang muli!
examples.translation: Isang mahalagang kalamangan ng virtual environment ay kapag nasira ang iyong Python environment, madali mo itong mabubura at magsisimula ulit!
examples.why: Verb focus switches mid-clause — "mabubura" is object-focus with "mo" as actor, then "magsisimula" is actor-focus with no actor supplied, which a native technical writer would not leave dangling; "kapag" also turns the English conditional "if" into "when".

examples.source: Follow the steps in the [Run your first circuit on hardware](/guides/hello-world) guide to run a circuit on real quantum hardware.
examples.suggested: Sundin ang mga hakbang sa gabay na [Patakbuhin ang iyong unang circuit sa hardware](/guides/hello-world) para patakbuhin ang isang circuit sa tunay na quantum hardware.
examples.translation: Sundin ang mga hakbang sa [Hello world](/guides/hello-world) para patakbuhin ang isang circuit sa tunay na quantum hardware.
examples.why: The descriptive link label was replaced with the bare page slug title, and the word "guide"/"gabay" was dropped; the meaning survives in the trailing clause, so this is a lost signpost rather than a misleading statement.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift or hallucination: the negation in "ang buong input ay hindi ibinibigay sa computation", the exactly-one promise ("mayroon lamang isang string na z"), the even/odd parity output convention, the "don't care" caveat, and the permutation-matrix/Euclidean-norm chain in the last 40% all match the English precisely, and query gate / oracle / black box / unitary / permutation matrix are kept consistently in English as the field does. What a native technical editor would still fix is translationese: "described shortly" and "will be discussed shortly" are both rendered as "sa lalong madaling panahon" (= "as soon as possible", a temporal-urgency idiom, not "further below"), "Finally" as "Sa wakas" (= "at last, after a long wait") where discourse-final "Panghuli" is wanted, and "The way it works is..." calqued as "Ang paraan ng pagtatrabaho nito" (pagtatrabaho = manual labour, not machine operation — "paggana" is the correct word). There is also one first-person register slip: the file uses inclusive "natin" everywhere except "sa mga argumento na aming pinipili" (exclusive "aming", excluding the reader) in the black-box paragraph, plus small grammar slips ("kaya isulatin natin" for "isulat natin", "magbigay inspirasyon" missing "ng", "kapag ibinalik natin ang ating atensyon" where "ibaling" is the idiom for turning one's attention). None of these would mislead a learner about the query model.

examples.source: with some simple examples described shortly … The precise way that this works for quantum algorithms will be discussed shortly
examples.suggested: na may ilang simpleng halimbawang ilalarawan sa ibaba / mamaya … ay tatalakayin sa ibaba
examples.translation: na may ilang simpleng halimbawa na inilalarawan sa lalong madaling panahon … ay tatalakayin sa lalong madaling panahon
examples.why: "sa lalong madaling panahon" is the fixed Tagalog idiom for "as soon as possible" (urgency), not for "shortly" in the sense of "a little further into the lesson". Used twice, it reads as machine translation; a native writer would say "sa ibaba" or "mamaya sa araling ito".

examples.source: The way it works is that the function $f$ is queried on the two possible inputs
examples.suggested: Ganito ito gumagana: ang function na $f$ ay ini-query sa dalawang posibleng input
examples.translation: Ang paraan ng pagtatrabaho nito ay ang function na $f$ ay ique-query sa dalawang posibleng input
examples.why: "pagtatrabaho" means manual work/employment, never the operation of a circuit; it is a word-for-word calque of "working". "paggana" (or a simple "Ganito ito gumagana") is what a Tagalog technical writer would use.

examples.source: we can only evaluate it on arguments we select
examples.suggested: maaari lang nating i-evaluate ito sa mga argumentong pinipili natin
examples.translation: maaari lang nating e-evaluate ito sa mga argumento na aming pinipili
examples.why: The whole file uses inclusive "natin/tayo" (author + reader), but "aming" is exclusive first-person plural, which momentarily writes the learner out of the "we" doing the selecting — inconsistent within the same sentence, which already uses "nating".

examples.source: Finally, the way that we'll measure efficiency of query algorithms is simple
examples.suggested: Panghuli, simple lang ang paraan ng pagsukat natin sa kahusayan ng mga query algorithm
examples.translation: Sa wakas, ang paraan na susukat tayo ng kahusayan ng mga query algorithm ay simple
examples.why: "Sa wakas" carries relief after a long wait ("at last!"), not the list-closing "finally"; "Panghuli" is the correct discourse marker. "ang paraan na susukat tayo" is also ungrammatical — the linker should be "kung paano natin susukatin" or the nominalized "ang paraan ng pagsukat natin".

examples.source: we sometimes come up with very complicated and highly contrived problems where it's difficult to imagine that anyone would ever actually want to solve them in practice
examples.suggested: minsan ay lumilikha tayo ng napakakomplikado at gawa-gawang mga problema na mahirap isiping may sinumang talagang gustong lutasin sa praktika
examples.translation: minsan ay lumilikha tayo ng napakakomplikado at lubhang gawa-gawa na mga problema kung saan mahirap isipin na may sinuman ay talagang gustong lutasin ang mga ito sa practice
examples.why: "na may sinuman ay talagang gustong" is ungrammatical Tagalog (an "ay"-inversion stranded after "may"); the linker should be "na may sinumang…". The bare English "in practice" is also left untranslated mid-sentence where "sa praktika" was available.

editor_note: No misleading drift: the quantum-threat framing ("збирати зараз і розшифрувати пізніше"), the 6–7 годин duration, the badge/assessment wording and the Admonition caveat ("не призначені для використання як реальні реалізації") all match the English, and informal "ти" holds throughout. What an editor would change: the same UI feature is named two different non-standard ways — "розгортні розділи" (expandable, §Course introduction) vs "згортних розділах" (collapsible, §Lesson structure); standard Ukrainian would be "розгортувані/згортувані розділи" used consistently. Two modality shifts also flatten the source's soft advice: "Readers … should explore" becomes the permissive "можуть дослідити", while "You may wish to download" becomes the prescriptive "Її варто завантажити". Smaller nits: "A maths primer" → "Математичний довідник" (a reference book rather than an introductory primer), and "highlighted" is dropped from the hover-help sentence.

examples.source: our expandable sections … / Some of these are in collapsible sections
examples.suggested: наші розгортувані розділи … / у згортуваних розділах
examples.translation: наші розгортні розділи … / містяться у згортних розділах
examples.why: The same collapsible-section UI element is named with two different (and non-standard) coinages within one short file; a learner cannot tell they refer to the same thing.

examples.source: You may wish to download so you can refer to it at a later point in time.
examples.suggested: Можливо, ти захочеш завантажити її, щоб звернутися до неї пізніше.
examples.translation: Її варто завантажити, щоб мати можливість звернутися до неї пізніше.
examples.why: An optional suggestion is strengthened into a recommendation ('варто' = you should), changing the source's deliberately low-pressure register.

examples.source: Readers desiring a deeper understanding … should explore our expandable sections and presentations
examples.suggested: …, варто переглянути наші розгортувані розділи та презентації
examples.translation: Читачі, які прагнуть глибшого розуміння …, можуть дослідити наші розгортні розділи та презентації
examples.why: 'should explore' (advice aimed at that audience) is softened to mere permission 'можуть дослідити', losing the pedagogical steer.

examples.source: A maths primer
examples.suggested: Вступ до математики (математичний мінімум)
examples.translation: Математичний довідник
examples.why: 'primer' is an introductory refresher, not a reference/lookup handbook ('довідник'); the rendering misdescribes what the linked presentation offers.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — every procedural step, version pin (`qiskit>=0.45,<1`, `1.0.0rc1`, 1 лютого 2024), negation and caveat (the "менш надійне"/invalid-environment warnings, the "lowest indentation" tip, the `qiskit-dynamics` example) tracks the English, and informal "ти" holds file-wide with no formal slips. Three word-level defects a native editor would fix: "Неможливо задатою датою змінити вимоги" is a garbled non-phrase where Ukrainian wants "заднім числом" (backdate); "пригнічити виняток" uses the wrong verb (пригнічувати = to oppress/depress; the term is "придушити/вимкнути виняток"); and "старих редагованих інсталяцій" is a literal calque of pip's "editable installations" (should be "інсталяцій у редагованому режимі (`pip install -e`)"). The "resolution" family is rendered as the calque "резолюція" ("помилка резолюції", "конфлікт резолюції", "одноетапної резолюції середовища") — consistent within the file, but Ukrainian technical usage is "розв'язання залежностей". Two qualifiers are lightly softened: "not-yet-compatible" → plain "несумісні" (loses "ще не"), and "We will not make similar breaking packaging changes" → "ми не плануємо вносити" (commitment weakened to an intention). None of these would mislead a learner about what to actually do.

examples.source: It's not possible to backdate requirements changes to previously released versions
examples.suggested: Неможливо заднім числом змінити вимоги у вже випущених версіях
examples.translation: Неможливо задатою датою змінити вимоги у вже випущених версіях
examples.why: «задатою датою» is not a Ukrainian phrase — it reads as a garbled form; the idiom for backdating is «заднім числом».

examples.source: You can suppress the exception by setting the environment variable
examples.suggested: Ти можеш придушити (вимкнути) виняток, встановивши змінну середовища
examples.translation: Ти можеш пригнічити виняток, встановивши змінну середовища
examples.why: «пригнічувати» means to oppress/depress a person or mood; the programming term for suppressing an exception is «придушити» or simply «вимкнути».

examples.source: a resolution failure / a true resolution conflict / single-environment resolution
examples.suggested: помилку розв'язання залежностей / справжній конфлікт розв'язання залежностей / одноетапного розв'язання середовища
examples.translation: помилку резолюції / справжній конфлікт резолюції / одноетапної резолюції середовища
examples.why: «резолюція» in Ukrainian means a formal decision/decree; dependency resolution is «розв'язання (залежностей)». Consistent within the file, so recognizable, but it is a calque.

examples.source: several packages are marked as not-yet-compatible with it
examples.suggested: кілька пакунків позначено як ще не сумісні з ним
examples.translation: кілька пакунків позначено як несумісні з ним
examples.why: Dropping «ще не» turns a temporary, to-be-fixed state into a flat incompatibility — the following sentence («доки не вийдуть нові версії») still implies the temporary reading, so the qualifier should be restored.

examples.source: We will not make similar breaking packaging changes in the future.
examples.suggested: Надалі ми не вноситимемо подібних breaking-змін у пакунках.
examples.translation: Надалі ми не плануємо вносити подібних breaking-змін у пакунках.
examples.why: The English is a commitment («will not»); «не плануємо» downgrades it to a current intention, weakening the reassurance that this is a one-time event.

editor_note: No semantic drift or hallucination: the technical claims all survive intact (25× shots = 10_000, $4k$ шарів двокубітних гейтів for $k$ time steps, ⟨IIIIIZ⟩ = 1 for the trivial input state, resilience levels 0/1/2), and the informal "ти" register holds throughout ("Зверни увагу", "Спробуй", "Зауваж", "дивись"). Four editorial slips remain. (1) "a second stage where it is reversed $U^\dagger$" is rendered "другого етапу, де вона обертається $U^\dagger$" — "обертається" reads as "rotates", not "is inverted"; the correct root here is "обернена"/"інвертується" (the dagger notation saves the learner, so this is not misleading, but a native editor would fix it). (2) "quantum (or readout) errors" leaves the lowercase English word untranslated: "квантові (або readout) помилки" instead of "помилки зчитування". (3) "shots" is rendered two ways in one bullet — "кількість вимірювань" then bare "10_000 shots". (4) The noise adjective is inconsistent: headings use "Шумова симуляція" (= simulation of noise) while the body correctly uses "зашумлене виконання"/"зашумлений семплер".

examples.source: a second stage where it is reversed $U^\dagger$
examples.suggested: другого етапу, де застосовується обернена схема $U^\dagger$
examples.translation: другого етапу, де вона обертається $U^\dagger$
examples.why: «обертається» in Ukrainian means «rotates/spins», not «is inverted»; the compute-uncompute idea depends on inversion, and the intended root is «обернений».

examples.source: We first need to define quantum (or readout) errors to add to a noise model.
examples.suggested: Спочатку треба визначити квантові помилки (або помилки зчитування), які додаватимуться до моделі шуму.
examples.translation: Спочатку треба визначити квантові (або readout) помилки, які додаватимуться до моделі шуму.
examples.why: Bare lowercase English «readout» inside Ukrainian prose; «зчитування» is the established Ukrainian term and is used implicitly elsewhere in the course.

examples.source: Try 25x number of shots (= 10_000 shots) and ensure that a smoother plot is obtained
examples.suggested: Спробуй збільшити кількість пострілів (shots) у 25 разів (= 10\_000) і переконайся, що графік стає плавнішим
examples.translation: Спробуй збільшити кількість вимірювань у 25 разів (= 10\_000 shots) і переконайся, що графік стає плавнішим
examples.why: Same term rendered two ways in one sentence — «кількість вимірювань» and then bare «shots»; pick one convention and keep it (the file elsewhere never fixes a Ukrainian rendering for shots).

editor_note: No semantic drift or hallucination: every prose paragraph (the AQC pattern walkthrough at L183, the dry-run caveat at L336, the validation paragraph at L149) tracks the English faithfully, and the informal "ти" register holds throughout. What a native editor would change is terminology consistency: "addon" is rendered three different ways in the same file — "надбудови Qiskit" (L14), left as "AQC addon" (L20, L26), and "доповненням Qiskit" (L764); and "expectation value" is "значення математичного сподівання" everywhere except L548, where it becomes "очікуване значення". Two register/accuracy slips: "hardware" is rendered as the colloquial "на залізі" at L538 while the rest of the file uses "апаратне забезпечення", and the ISA expansion at L135 is inverted — "набір інструкцій архітектури" instead of "архітектура набору інструкцій". Also a small grammatical slip at L461 ("задано модель ... та спостережувана величина" should be accusative "спостережувану величину") and a calqued "Ти можеш необов'язково використовувати `save_account()`" at L410 for "You can optionally use".

examples.source: the [AQC-Tensor](...) Qiskit addon … options for the AQC addon … a deeper dive into the AQC-Tensor Qiskit addon
examples.suggested: Pick one rendering of "Qiskit addon" (e.g. "доповнення Qiskit") and use it in all three places.
examples.translation: надбудови Qiskit [AQC-Tensor] … параметрів для AQC addon … доповненням Qiskit AQC-Tensor
examples.why: The same product concept appears under three labels in one page; a learner cannot tell whether "надбудова", "AQC addon" and "доповнення" are the same thing.

examples.source: These include the domain-level output of Hamiltonian simulation (expectation value) and useful metadata.
examples.suggested: …(значення математичного сподівання) і корисні метадані.
examples.translation: Вони включають вивід предметного рівня симуляції гамільтоніана (очікуване значення) і корисні метадані.
examples.why: Everywhere else in the file "expectation value" is "значення математичного сподівання"; the lone "очікуване значення" breaks the established convention for a core domain term.

examples.source: the two-qubit depth of the final ISA circuit intended for execution on hardware
examples.suggested: …призначеної для виконання на апаратному забезпеченні
examples.translation: глибину двокубітних вентилів фінальної ISA-схеми, призначеної для виконання на залізі
examples.why: "Залізо" is shop-floor slang and clashes with the neutral "апаратне забезпечення" used in the parallel sentences at L33 and L336.

examples.source: the two-qubit depth of the final instruction set architecture (ISA) circuit
examples.suggested: …фінальної схеми в архітектурі набору інструкцій (ISA)
examples.translation: глибиною двокубітних вентилів фінальної схеми в наборі інструкцій архітектури (ISA)
examples.why: The expansion of ISA is assembled in the wrong order — "набір інструкцій архітектури" reads as "the architecture's instruction set", so the acronym no longer matches the words it expands.

examples.source: You can optionally use `save_account()` to save your credentials
examples.suggested: За бажанням можеш скористатися `save_account()`, щоб зберегти облікові дані
examples.translation: Ти можеш необов'язково використовувати `save_account()`, щоб зберегти свої облікові дані
examples.why: "Необов'язково використовувати" is a word-for-word calque of "optionally use" and reads as machine output; a native writer would say "за бажанням" or "опційно".

editor_note: Nothing in this file would mislead a learner: every migration instruction, negation and caveat survives intact (e.g. "**не** були перенесені до `qiskit_ibm_runtime.fake_provider`", "фаза `2\\pi` зсуває на повний цикл, на відміну від дискретного аналога", the pub/PUB explanation and the V1-vs-V2 shot/precision distinction are all faithful), and the informal "ти" register is held throughout. What a native technical editor would still change is a small set of calques and one softened claim: the heading "Амплітуда комплексного значення" is a word-order calque of "Complex-valued amplitude" (natural Ukrainian would be "Комплекснозначна амплітуда"), "зачеплені класи" (for "affected classes") is colloquial where "класи, яких це стосується" is expected, and "сторонньої бібліотеки" renders "downstream library" as "third-party library". In the transpiler section, "Цей прохід більше не використовувався" states the pass "was no longer used" whereas the English says it was no longer *usable* (broken) — a softening, not a factual inversion. Two small qualifiers are also lost: "повністю видалено" adds an intensifier the English ("have been removed from the codebase") does not have, and the "first"/"instead" of "explicitly convert the argument by using `SparsePauliOp(pauli_list)` first" is dropped.

examples.source: Complex-valued amplitude / Complex-valued pulse amplitude (`amp`) is replaced by an (`amp`, `angle`) duo.
examples.suggested: Комплекснозначна амплітуда / Комплекснозначну амплітуду імпульсу (`amp`) замінено парою (`amp`, `angle`).
examples.translation: Амплітуда комплексного значення / Амплітуда імпульсу комплексного значення (`amp`) замінюється парою (`amp`, `angle`).
examples.why: Word-order calque: "амплітуда комплексного значення" reads as "amplitude of the complex value" rather than "complex-valued amplitude". A Ukrainian physicist writes "комплекснозначна амплітуда".

examples.source: This pass was no longer usable because its internal operation was dependent on custom properties being set in the `BackendProperties` payload
examples.suggested: Цей прохід більше не був придатним для використання, оскільки його внутрішня робота залежала від…
examples.translation: Цей прохід більше не використовувався, оскільки його внутрішня робота залежала від спеціальних властивостей, встановлених у `BackendProperties`
examples.why: "usable" (technically broken) is softened to "used" (merely unpopular); the English states the pass could not work at all, which is the actual reason for its removal.

examples.source: Most of the user-facing `qiskit.providers.fake_provider` components … Click through the following tabs to see the affected classes.
examples.suggested: …щоб побачити класи, яких це стосується.
examples.translation: Більшість користувацьких компонентів `qiskit.providers.fake_provider` … Переглянь наступні вкладки, щоб побачити зачеплені класи.
examples.why: "зачеплені класи" is colloquial/physical ("classes that got bumped"); technical Ukrainian uses "класи, яких це стосується" or "уражені зміною класи".

examples.source: If you depend on fake backends for unit testing a downstream library
examples.suggested: …для юніт-тестування залежної від Qiskit бібліотеки
examples.translation: Якщо ти залежиш від фейкових бекендів для юніт-тестування сторонньої бібліотеки
examples.why: "downstream" (a library built on top of Qiskit — i.e. the reader's own) becomes "сторонньої" (third-party, someone else's), inverting whose library is being tested.

examples.source: `qiskit.qasm2` does not expose the AST or any lower level implementation details about the parser
examples.suggested: …не розкриває AST чи будь-які низькорівневі деталі реалізації парсера
examples.translation: `qiskit.qasm2` не розкриває AST чи інші деталі реалізації парсера низького рівня
examples.why: "низького рівня" attaches to "парсера" instead of to "деталі", so it reads as "a low-level parser" rather than "lower-level details"; "інші" also weakens "any".

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inverted conditions, dropped caveats or hallucinated claims — and the informal "ти" register holds consistently in every card ("Побудуй", "Спробуй", "Удосконалюй свої результати"); domain terms are conventional and consistent (transpiler→транспілятор, error mitigation/suppression→пом'якшення/придушення помилок, primitives→примітиви, high-fidelity→високоточні). What a native technical editor would still change: "on the IBM fleet of quantum computers" is calqued as "на флоті квантових комп'ютерів" (флот = naval fleet; Ukrainian uses "парк"); the image alt "A graphic showing…" becomes "Графік, що показує…" (графік = chart/schedule, not "graphic"); the imperative in the Error-mitigation card is the wrong form, "Досліди" (reads as the noun "experiments") instead of "Дослідь"; "framework" is flattened to "платформу", which collides with "IBM Quantum Platform" two sentences later; and "no sign-in" is narrowed to "без реєстрації" (no registration) rather than "без входу". None of these would make a learner form a false belief.

examples.source: to run workloads efficiently on the IBM® fleet of quantum computers
examples.suggested: …на парку квантових комп'ютерів IBM®
examples.translation: для ефективного виконання робочих навантажень на флоті квантових комп'ютерів IBM®
examples.why: "Флот" in Ukrainian is a naval/air fleet; for a set of machines the idiomatic word is "парк". Direct calque of English "fleet".

examples.source: A graphic showing the different components of IBM Quantum Platform and Qiskit.
examples.suggested: Ілюстрація, що показує різні компоненти IBM Quantum Platform та Qiskit.
examples.translation: Графік, що показує різні компоненти IBM Quantum Platform та Qiskit.
examples.why: "Графік" means a chart/plot or a schedule, not a graphic/illustration — a reader relying on alt text would expect a plotted diagram.

examples.source: Explore the available error mitigation and suppression techniques available from IBM Quantum.
examples.suggested: Дослідь доступні методи пом'якшення та придушення помилок від IBM Quantum.
examples.translation: Досліди доступні методи пом'якшення та придушення помилок від IBM Quantum.
examples.why: Wrong imperative form: "досліди" is the plural noun "experiments"; the 2sg imperative of "дослідити" is "дослідь". Every other card uses a correct informal imperative, so this one stands out.

examples.source: Qiskit provides a modular and extensible framework … With it, researchers can build … with specialized addons, software tools, and extensive resources.
examples.suggested: …надає модульний та розширюваний фреймворк … За його допомогою дослідники можуть створювати … використовуючи спеціалізовані доповнення, програмні інструменти та широкий набір ресурсів.
examples.translation: Qiskit надає модульну та розширювану платформу … За його допомогою дослідники можуть створювати … за допомогою [спеціалізованих доповнень], програмних інструментів та великих ресурсів.
examples.why: "Framework"→"платформу" collides with "IBM Quantum Platform" in the next sentence; "великих ресурсів" is a literal rendering of "extensive resources"; and "за його допомогою … за допомогою" repeats the same phrase twice in one sentence.

examples.source: Build a quantum circuit in under two minutes - no sign-in or API key required.
examples.suggested: Побудуй квантову схему менш ніж за дві хвилини — без входу в систему чи ключа API.
examples.translation: Побудуй квантову схему менш ніж за дві хвилини — без реєстрації чи ключа API.
examples.why: "Sign-in" is narrowed to "реєстрація" (registration); the English promises you need not even log in with an existing account, which is a slightly stronger claim.

editor_note: The file splits the name of the *dephasing* channel Δ in a way that collides with the *depolarizing* channel Ω — the two channels this very lesson contrasts. In the Stinespring half Δ is correctly "повністю дефазуючий канал" (lines 95, 232, 362), but in the Kraus and Choi halves it is renamed "Повністю деполяризуючий канал за фазою" / "Повністю деполяризуючий за фазою канал" (lines 414, 416, 705, 707), sitting immediately next to the genuine "Повністю деполяризуючий канал" for Ω (lines 479, 722). A learner scanning the headings would read dephasing as a variety of depolarizing and form a false belief. Separately, the page's closing sentence is dropped: EN ends "The Choi representation does not directly describe a channel's action in the usual way that a matrix represents a linear mapping" — the explanation of *why* J(Id) is not the identity matrix — and the UK file simply stops after "не є одиничною матрицею" (line 776). Smaller items: "positive semidefinite" is rendered with the non-word "напівдовизначена" (lines 674, 697); "trace" is split between "траса" (часткова траса, "береться в трасу") and the correct "слід" (lines 395, 685); and Stinespring is transliterated "Штайнспрінг" throughout but "Стайнспрінга" at line 616.

examples.source: ### Completely dephasing channel
examples.suggested: ### Повністю дефазуючий канал
examples.translation: ### Повністю деполяризуючий канал за фазою
examples.why: Δ is the dephasing channel, not a depolarizing one. Because the very next section (line 479) is the genuine 'Повністю деполяризуючий канал' (Ω), the two distinct channels end up with near-identical Ukrainian names, and the first half of the same file already uses the correct 'дефазуючий' (lines 95, 232, 362). This teaches the learner that dephasing is a flavour of depolarizing.

examples.source:
Notice in particular that $J(\operatorname{Id})$ is not the identity matrix.
The Choi representation does not directly describe a channel's action in the usual way that a matrix represents a linear mapping.
examples.suggested:
Зауважимо зокрема, що $J(\operatorname{Id})$ не є одиничною матрицею.
Представлення Чоя не описує дію каналу безпосередньо — не так, як матриця зазвичай представляє лінійне відображення.
examples.translation: Зауважимо зокрема, що $J(\operatorname{Id})$ не є одиничною матрицею.
examples.why: The final sentence of the lesson is missing. It is the explanation that resolves the surprise stated just before it; without it the learner is left with a bare counter-intuitive fact and no reason for it.

examples.source: the Choi matrix of a channel must always be positive semidefinite
examples.suggested: матриця Чоя каналу завжди має бути додатно напіввизначеною
examples.translation: матриця Чоя каналу завжди має бути позитивно напівдовизначеною
examples.why: 'напівдовизначений' is not a Ukrainian word — the standard term for positive semidefinite is 'додатно напіввизначений' (or 'невід'ємно визначений'). The malformed coinage appears in both statements of this key condition.

examples.source: traced out / preserves trace
examples.suggested: береться частковий слід / стежиться (береться слід) по системі — consistently with 'слід'
examples.translation: береться часткова траса / береться в трасу — vs — зберігають слід, збереження $\Phi$ сліду
examples.why: The matrix trace is 'слід' in Ukrainian; 'траса' means a route or track and is a false friend. The file uses 'траса' for the partial trace but the correct 'слід' for trace preservation, so one concept is carried by two unrelated words within the same lesson.

examples.source: In contrast, Stinespring and Kraus representations are not unique in this way
examples.suggested: На відміну від цього, представлення Штайнспрінга та Крауса не є унікальними в цьому сенсі
examples.translation: На відміну від цього, представлення Стайнспрінга та Крауса не є унікальними в цьому сенсі
examples.why: Single-instance transliteration slip: the name is rendered 'Штайнспрінг' everywhere else in the file (lines 26, 31, 33, 77, 79, 80, 83, 88, 97).
